name: diesel_injection_sizing
title: Diesel injection sizing (TP5 exercise 4)
summary: Teaching exercise: injection duration, volumetric efficiency and mixture richness of a four-stroke diesel. Start and end of injection fix the duration; the air mass in one cylinder follows from the volumetric efficiency; the injected fuel mass follows from the richness. The fuel is a mass.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP5, exercise 4 (diesel injection sizing).
